## The task this checkpoint assesses

This required checkpoint combines a short knowledge check with one practical
artifact. Review lesson notebooks when needed, then complete the final attempt
without copying a finished solution.

## 2. Complete the practical task

Turn a small study-summary script into a package-style project with a CLI entry point, declared dependencies, focused pytest tests, formatting, linting, type checking, and one CI workflow.

Work in small steps: predict one result, run the smallest useful example,
compare the evidence, and change one thing at a time.

### Evidence to keep

1. A tree showing the project layout.
2. Commands to create the environment and run the cli.
3. Passing test, format, lint, and type-check outputs.
4. A ci run or locally validated ci configuration.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A useful completion check"}
A finished artifact runs from a clean start, contains no unexplained copied
code, and gives another learner enough instructions to reproduce your result.
If one of those statements is false, improve that specific gap before recording
completion.
:::

## 3. Decide whether the outcome is demonstrated

Record this checkpoint only when all four statements are true:

- [ ] I scored at least 3/4 on the knowledge check.
- [ ] My practical artifact runs from a clean start.
- [ ] I kept the requested output, checks, and explanation evidence.
- [ ] I can make one new change without copying a solution.
